TRADITION & COLOUR · CONCEPT STORY

The courtyard celebration

An intimate ceremony concept where warm architecture and joyful flowers do the talking.

✳

THE PALETTE

  • Marigold
  • Terracotta
  • Ivory

THE DETAILS

  • A marigold-framed ceremonial setting
  • Ivory textiles against warm architecture
  • Traditional accents used with restraint

Begin with the atmosphere

A courtyard already has a character of its own. Rather than covering it, this concept works with the texture of the walls, the rhythm of the arches and the warmth of the light.

Bring the details together

Marigold garlands create a clear ceremonial focal point. Pale seating and restrained brass accents balance the colour, while the surrounding space stays open for family and friends.

Make room for your story

Share the scale and photographs of your venue when exploring this direction. The ceremony requirements, access routes and guest seating should guide the final arrangement.
